channel.description: Latest articles from The Motley Fool UK (fool.co.uk)

item.title: This brilliant REIT boasts an 8.18% yield
item.description: Jon Smith points to a REIT that not only has a high dividend yield, but has strong fundamentals he feels makes it an even more compelling idea.

item.title: Why don't Brits like Stocks and Shares ISAs?
item.description: Our Foolish author was quite shocked to discover this surprising new statistic about Brits' views on Stocks and Shares ISAs.

item.title: 3 UK stocks tipped to grow 100% (or more) in 2026
item.description: Mark Hartley breaks down the investment case behind three UK stocks that have been forecast to double in value this year. Too good to be true?

item.title: Prediction: in 2026 the BP share price and dividend could turn £10,000 into…
item.description: Harvey Jones says the BP share price can be turbulent but with buybacks and dividends on offer, it should help him build wealth over the longer term.

item.title: £20k spent on this rocketing FTSE 250 share a year ago is now worth…
item.description: Someone investing in this FTSE 250 growth share a year ago would have doubled their money! Can it continue rising? Royston Wild investigates.

item.title: Starting 2026 with £20k? Here's how to try and turn that into a second income
item.description: How can investors get the most bang for their buck with second income in 2026? Our Foolish author explains one popular approach.

item.title: After 100 years, is this FTSE 250 trust about to disappear?
item.description: A century-old investment trust from the FTSE 250 index is facing a crucial vote tomorrow. What's going on -- and is it worth me investing in it?

item.title: With a P/E ratio of 12 and an 8.55% dividend yield, are Taylor Wimpey shares a no-brainer?
item.description: Taylor Wimpey shares offer one of the biggest dividend yields on the London Stock Exchange. But are they truly worth buying today?

item.title: How big does an ISA need to be to generate a £100k second income?
item.description: Ben McPoland highlights how it's possible for a Stocks and Shares ISA portfolio to one day throw off life-enhancing sums of money.

item.title: Could the Greggs share price double in 5 years?
item.description: The Greggs share price has more than halved since late 2021. Our writer explains why he thinks it might ultimately get back to its old level again.
